newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Brierley unit buys Manco, 20 pct owner of Cedenco.
newsitem.headline: Brierley unit buys Manco, 20 pct owner of Cedenco.

text.p: Brierley Investments Ltd said on Monday its subsidiary, Eglett Investments Ltd, had agreed to buy Manco Ltd, which owns 20 percent of fruit and vegetable processor Cedenco Ltd.
Manco was established in 1993 by a group of Cedenco executives, who received assistance from BIL.
BIL said it would buy Manco for a nominal consideration and an assumption of net debt exposure under existing banking arrangements which were guaranteed at the time of Manco's establishment.
The shares are transferred to BIL at an effective price of $1.93 per share and after the purchase BIL will own 48.5 percent of Cedenco. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 4734 746
